skill.evade.evader.desc:
Increases the maximum level of Evade Window and Evade Distance by 1 each
Attack power becomes 1.3 times for 10 seconds after a successful dodge
Increases attack power by 1.3× when health is at or below 25%
Automatically dodges an attack once every 15 seconds
Negates damage that is not caused by an attacker
skill.evade.attack_boost.desc: Increases attack power by 0.1× per skill level (Max VII)
skill.evade.evade_window.desc: Increases dodge invincibility duration by 1 tick per skill level (Max IV)
skill.evade.dodge_recovery.desc: Reduces dodge cooldown by 1 tick per skill level (Max III)
modifier.evade.dodge_basics.description: Lets you dodge with the dodge key
modifier.evade.air_dodge.flavor: Evade even where the ground cannot reach.
modifier.evade.evader_halo.description: Grants every effect of the Evade Halo
